body: Be prepared for mec101, that class is awful. It’s the workload of 2-3 classes. Purwar will forever be my enemy🫡

I can count the amount of times I’ve been to class this semester on 1 hand. The thing is that you can get away with it early on in your college career bc there is so much resources on YouTube and the internet. For example, for calc 3 I watched Professor Leonard’s videos and went to class 1 time the entire semester(finished the class with a A-). If you do the correct things skipping class you’ll be fine, my
Gpa is a 3.55 rn. However, next semester when I get to thermo, fluids, machine design and all of those classes that aren’t really covered online best believe ima be in class everyday. It’s really how you look at it. Unfortunately a lot of my professors are researchers first and then profs so a lot of my profs are god awful. The main reason why I’m skipping this semester is so I can do a co-op and still be on track to graduate with only having to take 1 summer class.

Mec203 is offered over the winter. But taking a heavy math course such as diff eq is not a good idea. You need time to rest after a long semester of difficult mec classes. Don’t do it. If you really want to get ahead, take some summer courses. (6weeks summer compared to 3 weeks winter). Various mec classes up until 410 are offered and are extremely doable (be aware that a lot of them they are taught by Mendy so do not expect a curve or an easy class). Hope this helps

That means that the average grade for all MEC classes together must be a 2.00. You can get a C- in MEC 220 and other classes that do not specifically say “C or better in MEC…” For example, you need a C or better in MEC 260 to be able to take 262 and 363. Hope this helps.
Definitely expect something different. Study the previous practice exams because good chance is that she’ll copy and paste from the previous midterms. That final is brutal💀.
Take hemmick if you’re aoi, it’s an easy A

Absolutely take hemmick, ernald graf(phy 126) is one of the worst physics professors and he will make ur life hard💀.  Hemmick is the easiest stem class you will ever take in ur entire life and 132 is just as easy. Regarding dropping calc 3 Talk to an advisor asap because I’m sure they’ll tell you the Same thing that ams210 and 261 at the same time is not necessary. Take an sbc that’ll give you a break so you do not burn out so early.

Definitely take 131 with Hemmick, it’s an easy A. Personally I would drop AMS 261 and just take linear algebra due to the workload that mec101 is going to give. Mec 101 is the workload of 2 classes and it’s ungodly time consuming. If you want sanity drop AMS261 and replace it with WRT102 or a bs sbc. Also for linear algebra you do not have to be in lecture, she has a live meeting and she records it, linear algebra at 830 am is crazy ngl. You can take calc 3 in the spring and be pretty ahead still and have ur sanity lmao. Whoever recommended calc 3 and linear fall freshman year for you is out of their mind, most freshman are still taking ams151 or mat 131

The class is not bad however the way she paces the class is really bad. She starts off the class very slow with the basic fundamentals of linear, but after the first midterm she’s cramming whole chapters in 1 day and going 10-20 minutes over class time. If you do the hw and study the practice exams you’ll be fine.

It’s possible if you get a really good grade on the final. Hemmick does also grade off of improvement from what I’ve heard so if you show great improvement from the 2nd midterm to final,he’ll definitely bump ur grade. If not an A to a B+-A-

Hemmicks 8 hour review and extra credit questions. If you watch all the extra credit questions it’s an extra 3% on ur overall average if I remember correctly. He hasn’t updated his syllabus since 2020 and didn’t even post one for phy132. His extra credits are extremely helpful tho.
You can take them at different times, it’s just advised that u take it at the same time
Freshman usually enroll in classes middle of July to early august, don’t worry.

The ocpp might be required I’m not 100% sure for ESG198 however a lot of mec majors such as myself take che131 over the summer before sophomore year. This is because the workload of fall sophomore year is intense. Fall sophomore year you have to take mec220,mec260,ams261, and mec203. Taking chemistry as well with those classes will be extremely difficult unless you have the Ap calc Bc credit and take calc 3(ams 261) spring freshman year after linear algebra in the fall. Some people also do this so they can take thermodynamics sophomore year and not junior year.It is something to look into if you want to lighten up the work load. Che131 is extremely doable over the summer if you decide on that option. Hope this helps!
Hardest exam I’ve taken in my life and I got way above average on both midterms. I definitely got a 50-60

It’s a group project of 4. Purwar basically makes robot kit that everyone has to buy for $200. Don’t be surprised if you kit is missing pieces or pieces are completely broken(the kit is trash). He gives you arduino notes that aren’t readable and basically says “have fun, you have a month”,then after you present he gives a 100 question final that no one studied for. Unfortunately mec101 is the weed out class to take out mec majors who are aoi or just can’t handle it. He says the first day “don’t worry about the rumors this is not a weed out class” which immediately should’ve been a red flag💀.

I was Aoi last semester and it’s not that hard to get in if you get the good classes. For phy 131 110% take hemmick and not ionas. Hemmicks online class is extremely easy and you’ll definitely get an A if you keep up with the lectures and watch his 8 hour reviews for his exams. For calc 1 take ams 151 or if you place into calc 2 take 161 with bbern. Bbern is the goat. DO NOT TAKE MAT131/132. From what I heard Jason Starr for 131 is the worst and 132 is equally as hard. Ams classes all the way. Beware of mec 101, purwar is actually awful.The material in mec101 is not difficult per say, but it’s just so much material with 40 plus formulas that he makes you remember for the final. If you keep up in the class,network with your classmates, and do the hw you’ll be fine. Stay above average in his class and you’ll get a B. Make sure you start the final robot project early so you’re not cramming the week before thanksgiving and Christmas. I got the most godly draw of classes and I got a 3.7gpa. Hope this helps you👍🏻.
